title: Greek Stifado Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek beef stew made with onions, garlic, and a hint of zesty spice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground bouncy and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground zesty and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomato paste, beef broth, and stifado. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
